messages:
Maya R: onboarding CI failed for new model 'barracuda-7b'. validator: config.json schema error + tokenizer mismatch. anyone familiar with this model?

Raj P: seeing the CI log — weights path not found + unknown field `prefill_strategy` in config.json. weights should be in s3://redwood-models/barracuda/7b/. did upload complete?

Eli: tokenizer warnings: no `pad_token` set and special token ids > vocab_size. model came from community repo, their tokenizer config uses `additional_special_tokens`. might need remap.

Infra-bot: CI job #7421 failed: schema-lint error: unknown field `prefill_strategy` at /generation/prefill_strategy.
Exit code: 1
Full log: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/7421 (internal)

Maya R: ok — two issues then: 1) unknown config field, 2) tokenizer mismatches. For (1) are we rejecting by default or allowing unknowns with a warning?

Ben K: current validator (v2) is strict by default — unknown fields fail. we added that to prevent silent typos. for backwards compat we can: add a `compatibility` flag in schema or bump schema version and add migration.

Dani S: +1 to migration. we should avoid ad-hoc allowlists. converter could translate `prefill_strategy` -> `prefix_fill_mode` if it's actually a naming change. but need tests.

Maya R: what's the minimal patch to get this onboarding unblocked? can we hotfix CI to allow this model while we do a proper migration?

Raj P: two quick options: a) short-term: add `prefill_strategy` to allowed unknowns for this onboarding (unsafe but fast) b) map in the model onboarding script before linting: run small JS/py snippet to rewrite keys.

Eli: also need to normalise tokenizer: add `pad_token` with id `0` and clamp special token ids to < vocab_size. snippet I used locally:
```py
# naive fixer
cfg = json.load(open('config.json'))
if 'prefill_strategy' in cfg.get('generation', {}):
    cfg['generation']['prefix_fill_mode'] = cfg['generation'].pop('prefill_strategy')
if 'pad_token' not in cfg.get('tokenizer', {}):
    cfg.setdefault('tokenizer', {})['pad_token'] = '<|pad|>'
json.dump(cfg, open('config.fixed.json','w'), indent=2)
```

Ben K: that mapping is fine as a short-term patch. but let's record the mapping in schema changelog and add a validator test. failing silently would be bad.

Cam L: can someone own the quick patch + push? I'll review. also need an integration test that the onboarding pipeline accepts the fixed config and the model loads.

Maya R: I can push the pre-processor patch (small script) and update onboarding job to run it before schema-lint. will add a `// TODO` comment to remove when we bump schema. pinging @Ben K for review. :eyes:

Ben K: will review in ~30m. also add a unit test under eng-ml/tests/schema to assert `prefill_strategy` maps to `prefix_fill_mode`.

Dani S: for tokenizer, can we add a small check that signals if special token ids >= vocab_size and auto-fix? put it behind `--auto-fix` flag so we don't hide problems by default.

Eli: yep I'll add `--auto-fix-tokenizer` to the preprocessor. it will log the changes and emit a warning message in CI output. example log line: `Tokenizer: pad_token set to <|pad|>, remapped 3 special token ids`.

Infra-bot: CI triggered for PR #5023 (maya/onboard-barracuda). status: running.

Cam L: also double-check weights S3 upload. @Raj P can you confirm the object checksum? last time uploads got truncated.

Raj P: I re-uploaded with multipart, checksum matches. path: s3://redwood-models/barracuda/7b/weights.pt (md5: 9a4f2c...). confirmed reachable from our staging infra.

Maya R: thanks. plan: 1) open PR with preprocessor script + auto-fix flags, 2) update onboarding CI to run it, 3) Ben adds unit test, 4) Eli adds tokenizer fixer, 5) Dani will file schema-migration ticket to v3. Hey @Cam L can you do the integration review once PR is up?

Cam L: yes. please include the CI link and a before/after config diff in the PR description.

Maya R: PR created: https://git.redwood/internal/eng-ml/pull/5023 — added changelog entry and notes. temporary opt-in behavior. please review. :thumbsup:

Ben K: reviewing now. if all green we can unblock onboarding today.

Eli: will add tokenizer auto-fix shortly. leaving small TODO to remove auto-fix after migration.

Maya R: thanks team — will merge after Ben approves and CI passes. will follow up on the schema migration ticket. :rocket:
